packageRules.description: MassTransit 9 replaced the Apache-2.0 licence of the 8.x line with the commercial massient.com licence, which is non-transferable, non-sublicensable and forbids redistribution. This repository stays on 8.x by decision of the maintainer on 2026-09-04; the pin in Directory.Packages.props is the range [8.5.10,9.0.0) for the same reason. Minor and patch updates inside 8.x are still offered.
